caption: A wax crayon lies on a hot skillet, and it softens, slumps, and melts into a coloured pool.

sa.check: A wax crayon lies on the skillet.
The crayon melts into a pool.
The pool is the same colour as the crayon.
The softening comes first and the pool follows.

pc.expect: The crayon only softens, slumps and shrinks while the pool grows; it does not firm up again on the pan.
pc.fail: The crayon straightens or regains its round shape; or the pool draws back into the crayon; or the wax sets into a solid stick again in the pan; or the crayon alternates between stiff and slumped.

pc.expect: The crayon is a soft solid that bends and sags from the side touching the metal and the melt is a thin liquid that spreads.
pc.fail: The crayon shatters into dry pieces; or the pool stands as a rigid dome; or the crayon stretches like elastic; or the melt moves as a solid slab across the pan.

pc.expect: The crayon sags downward onto the pan and the pool spreads outward and downhill across it.
pc.fail: The crayon bends upward with nothing lifting it; or the pool climbs the pan's wall and stays; or melted wax lifts off the pan; or the pool gathers uphill of the crayon on a tilted pan.

pc.expect: The crayon melts where it touches the metal: it goes glossy underneath first and the pool spreads from beneath it.
pc.fail: The crayon melts from its top face while its underside stays matt and sharp; or a pool spreads on a part of the pan the crayon never touched; or the crayon slumps while the pan around it stays dry.

pc.expect: One crayon; the wax goes only into the pool.
pc.fail: The crayon grows; or a second crayon appears; or the crayon vanishes while still whole; or wax appears across the pan with none flowing there.

pc.expect: The pool keeps the crayon's colour, and the pan's finish and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The pool is a different colour from the crayon; or the pan changes colour; or items around the pan rearrange.
